neutral.EN: That's a horde. We fighting through or pulling back?
neutral.TL: Kawan iyan. Lalaban ba tayo o uurong?

neutral.EN: Look at that crowd. Do we stand our ground or run?
neutral.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami nila. Maninindigan ba tayo o tatakbo?

neutral.EN: Huge pack ahead. What's the call: fight or retreat?
neutral.TL: Malaking kawan sa unahan. Anong pasya: lalaban o aatras?

neutral.EN: That is a serious horde. Do we engage or bypass?
neutral.TL: Matinding kawan 'yan. Lalabanan ba natin o iiwasan?

neutral.EN: They're swarming. Are we cutting through or falling back?
neutral.TL: Dumudumog sila. Babasagin ba natin o aatras tayo?

neutral.EN: Too many bodies out there. What do you want to do?
neutral.TL: Napakaraming patay sa labas. Ano ang gusto mong gawin?

neutral.EN: Horde spotted. We taking them on or finding another route?
neutral.TL: May kawan sa unahan. Lalabanan ba natin o maghahanap ng ibang daan?

neutral.EN: Massive group approaching. Engage or evacuate?
neutral.TL: Napakalaking grupo ang papalapit. Lalaban o lilikas?

neutral.EN: That's a swarm. Give the order: fight or retreat?
neutral.TL: Kawan 'yan. Mag-utos ka: laban o urong?

neutral.EN: Look at that numbers disadvantage. Stand or withdraw?
neutral.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami nila laban sa atin. Tatayo o aatras?

warm.EN: That's a lot of them. Stay close—fight or fall back?
warm.TL: Ang dami nila. Dumikit ka—lalaban o uurong?

warm.EN: Too many for comfort, friend. What's your gut say: fight or run?
warm.TL: Masyadong marami para maging panatag, kaibigan. Anong kutob mo: laban o takbo?

warm.EN: Stay right next to me. Do we take them together or get out?
warm.TL: Manatili ka sa tabi ko. Sabay ba nating lalabanan o aalis tayo?

warm.EN: That swarm is dangerous. I want us alive—fight or retreat?
warm.TL: Delikado ang kawang 'yan. Gusto kong mabuhay tayo—laban o urong?

warm.EN: I'm with you whatever you decide. Are we pushing through or retreating?
warm.TL: Kasama mo ako kahit anong desisyon mo. Susulong ba tayo o aatras?

warm.EN: Careful, partner. That's a massive pack. Call the play.
warm.TL: Mag-ingat, kasama. Malaking kawan 'yan. Sabihin mo ang plano.

warm.EN: Look out, friend! Do we clear them or save our strength and run?
warm.TL: Mag-ingat, kaibigan! Uubusin ba natin sila o magtitipid ng lakas at tatakbo?

warm.EN: They're everywhere. Stick by me—fight or fall back?
warm.TL: Nasa lahat sila ng sulok. Dumikit ka—laban o urong?

warm.EN: I trust your call. Are we taking this swarm on or heading back?
warm.TL: Tiwala ako sa pasya mo. Lalabanan ba natin ang kawang ito o babalik?

warm.EN: Big herd ahead. Don't worry, we're a team. What's the plan?
warm.TL: Malaking kawan sa unahan. Huwag kang mag-alala, magkasama tayo. Anong plano?

terse.EN: Too many. Call it: stand or run?
terse.TL: Sobra sila. Magpasya: tayo o takbo?
Kawan sa unahan. Laban o urong?

terse.EN: Dozens of them. Stand or flee?
Crowd ahead. Fight or back off?
terse.TL: Grupo sa harap. Laban o atras?

guarded.EN: Big group ahead. We decide now: engage or avoid.
guarded.TL: Malaking grupo sa harap. Magpasya tayo ngayon: lumaban o umiwas.

guarded.EN: That horde will tear us apart if we hesitate. What's the move?
guarded.TL: Lalapain tayo ng kawang 'yan kapag nag-atubili tayo. Anong galaw?

guarded.EN: Bad odds. We fight with discipline or we slip away right now.
guarded.TL: Masamang tsansa. Lumaban nang may disiplina o tumakas agad ngayon.

guarded.EN: I'm not dying here. Decide: cut through or fall back?
guarded.TL: Di ako mamamatay dito. Magpasya ka: basagin o umatras?

guarded.EN: Check the numbers. Engage only if we have choke points.
guarded.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami. Lumaban lang kung may masisikipang daan.

guarded.EN: Horde is closing in. Make a choice before they surround us.
guarded.TL: Palapit na ang kawan. Pumili bago nila tayo mapaligiran.

guarded.EN: We can't afford mistakes against that herd. Stand or withdraw?
guarded.TL: Di tayo pwede magkamali sa kawang 'yan. Lalaban o aatras?

guarded.EN: Watch the flanks. Do we fight or get the hell out?
guarded.TL: Bantayan ang tagiliran. Lalaban ba tayo o aalis na agad?

guarded.EN: They'll overwhelm an open position. Call it now.
guarded.TL: Tatalunin nila tayo sa bukas na lugar. Magpasya ka na.

guarded.EN: Huge pack. If we fight, nobody breaks formation.
guarded.TL: Malaking kawan. Kung lalaban, walang sisira sa pormasyon.

neutral.EN: We can take them.
neutral.TL: Kaya natin sila.

neutral.EN: We've handled worse. Let's clear them.
neutral.TL: Nakalusot na tayo sa mas malala. Ubusin natin sila.

neutral.EN: Stand firm. We fight through.
neutral.TL: Tumayo nang matatag. Lalabanan natin sila.

neutral.EN: We have the weapons. Let's put them down.
neutral.TL: Nasa atin ang armas. Patumbahin natin sila.

neutral.EN: Ready up. We're not running from this.
neutral.TL: Humanda ka. Hindi natin tatakbuhan ito.

neutral.EN: We take the fight to them. Stay sharp.
neutral.TL: Sasalubungin natin sila. Maging alerto.

neutral.EN: Line them up. We can win this.
neutral.TL: Pilahin sila. Kayang-kaya natin ito.

neutral.EN: No backing down. We push through.
neutral.TL: Walang atrasan. Babasagin natin 'to.

neutral.EN: We hold here and eliminate the threat.
neutral.TL: Dito tayo tatayo at aalisin ang banta.

neutral.EN: I'm ready. Let's make every strike count.
neutral.TL: Handa na ako. Tiyaking may tama ang bawat palo.

warm.EN: I'm with you. We can take them.
warm.TL: Kasama mo ako. Kaya natin sila.

warm.EN: Together, nothing can stop us! Let's do this.
warm.TL: Kapag magkasama tayo, walang makapipigil sa atin! Tara na.

warm.EN: I've got your back, friend. We fight as one.
warm.TL: Hawak ko ang likod mo, kaibigan. Iisang laban tayo.

warm.EN: We survive together, we fight together. Let's clear them out!
warm.TL: Sabay tayong nabubuhay, sabay tayong lalaban. Ubusin natin sila!

warm.EN: With you beside me, I'm not afraid. Let's take them down.
warm.TL: Dahil katabi kita, hindi ako natatakot. Patumbahin natin sila.

warm.EN: Let's show them what real survivors are made of!
warm.TL: Ipakita natin sa kanila kung ano ang tunay na nakaligtas!

warm.EN: Right by your side, partner. We won't lose today.
warm.TL: Nasa tabi mo lang ako, kasama. Hindi tayo matatalo ngayon.

warm.EN: I trust us. Let's stand tall and fight.
warm.TL: Tiwala ako sa atin. Tumindig tayo at lumaban.

warm.EN: We've got this, friend. Watch my back and I'll watch yours.
warm.TL: Kayang-kaya natin, kaibigan. Bantayan ang isa't isa.

warm.EN: Stay close and hit hard! We'll celebrate after.
warm.TL: Manatiling dikit at humampas nang malakas! Magdiriwang tayo mamaya.

guarded.EN: If we commit, we hit hard and stay together.
guarded.TL: Kung lalaban tayo, sabay at todo ang tira.

guarded.EN: No heroics. Funnel them into a choke point and execute.
guarded.TL: Walang magpapakabayani. Ipitin sila sa sikip at tapusin.

guarded.EN: Watch your stamina. Don't swing wild and get exhausted.
guarded.TL: Bantayan ang lakas. Huwag magwala para di kapusin ng hangin.

guarded.EN: Keep the line tight. If one falls, we both die.
guarded.TL: Higpitan ang pormasyon. Kapag may bumagsak, patay tayong dalawa.

guarded.EN: Target the leaders first. Clear them systematically.
guarded.TL: Unahin ang mga nasa harap. Ubusin nang may sistema.

guarded.EN: We fight, but maintain an escape route behind us.
guarded.TL: Lalaban tayo, pero tiyaking may takasan sa likod natin.

guarded.EN: Every strike must be lethal. No wasted energy.
guarded.TL: Bawat tama dapat nakamamatay. Walang sayang na lakas.

guarded.EN: Don't let them surround us. Push when I push.
guarded.TL: Huwag magpapaligid sa kanila. Sumulong kapag sumulong ako.

guarded.EN: We can win this if we keep cool heads and steady hands.
guarded.TL: Mananalo tayo kung mananatiling malamig ang ulo at matatag ang kamay.

guarded.EN: Agreed. Take out the front rank and hold the doorway.
guarded.TL: Sang-ayon. Patumbahin ang unahan at hawakan ang pinto.

neutral.EN: Too many. We should pull back.
neutral.TL: Sobra sila. Dapat umatras tayo.

neutral.EN: The odds are terrible. Let's retreat and find another way.
neutral.TL: Napakasama ng tsansa. Umatras tayo at maghanap ng ibang daan.

neutral.EN: Fighting here is a death sentence. Fall back.
neutral.TL: Kamatayan ang lumaban dito. Umatras na.

neutral.EN: We don't have the ammunition or stamina for this. Pull back.
neutral.TL: Kulang tayo sa bala at lakas para rito. Umatras.

neutral.EN: Better to live and fight another day. Let's withdraw.
neutral.TL: Mas mabuting mabuhay para lumaban sa ibang araw. Umatras tayo.

neutral.EN: We're completely outmatched. Retreat orderly.
neutral.TL: Lupig tayo sa dami nila. Umatras nang maayos.

neutral.EN: Back up slowly. Don't make sudden noises.
neutral.TL: Umatras nang dahan-dahan. Huwag gumawa ng ingay.

neutral.EN: Let's slip away while they haven't locked onto us.
neutral.TL: Tumakas na tayo habang hindi pa sila nakapokus sa atin.

neutral.EN: Too risky. We need to withdraw immediately.
neutral.TL: Masyadong mapanganib. Kailangan nating umatras agad.

neutral.EN: I agree with retreating. Turn around and move quietly.
neutral.TL: Sang-ayon akong umatras. Lumingon at lumakad nang tahimik.

warm.EN: I'd rather get us out of this alive. Pull back.
warm.TL: Mas gusto kong makaalis tayong buhay. Umatras tayo.

warm.EN: I care too much about you to risk this. Let's retreat, friend.
warm.TL: Masyado kitang pinahahalagahan para isugal ito. Umatras tayo, kaibigan.

warm.EN: Please, let's fall back together. We don't have to die here.
warm.TL: Pakiusap, sabay tayong umatras. Di natin kailangang mamatay rito.

warm.EN: I need you alive, partner. Turn around, let's go.
warm.TL: Kailangan kitang buhay, kasama. Lumingon ka, tara na.

warm.EN: Let's save our strength for our people back home. Retreat.
warm.TL: Itabi natin ang lakas natin para sa kasama sa kampo. Umatras.

warm.EN: Take my hand if you need to, but we have to pull back now.
warm.TL: Hawakan mo ang kamay ko kung kailangan, pero aatras na tayo ngayon.

warm.EN: There's no shame in living to fight tomorrow. Fall back with me.
warm.TL: Walang kahihiyan sa pananatiling buhay. Umatras ka kasama ko.

warm.EN: Let's back away gently, together. I've got you.
warm.TL: Umatras tayo nang marahan, nang magkasama. Hawak kita.

warm.EN: We can find supplies elsewhere. Let's keep each other safe and run.
warm.TL: Makakahanap tayo ng gamit sa iba. Manatiling ligtas at tumakbo.

warm.EN: I'm not leaving without you, so let's both back up right now.
warm.TL: Di ako aalis nang wala ka, kaya umatras tayong pareho ngayon.

guarded.EN: Bad odds. Give them space.
guarded.TL: Masama ang tsansa. Lumayo tayo.

guarded.EN: Fighting that pack is suicide. Withdraw in formation.
guarded.TL: Pagpapakamatay ang labanang 'yan. Umatras nang may pormasyon.

guarded.EN: Step back quietly. Do not alert the rear flank.
guarded.TL: Umatras nang tahimik. Huwag gisingin ang nasa likod.

guarded.EN: Keep your weapon raised, but reverse your footsteps.
guarded.TL: Itaas ang armas, pero ihakbang pabalik ang paa.

guarded.EN: We have zero tactical advantage. We fall back immediately.
guarded.TL: Wala tayong kalamangan sa posisyon. Aatras tayo agad.

guarded.EN: Don't let adrenaline make you stupid. We withdraw.
guarded.TL: Huwag magpadala sa kaba at maging tanga. Aatras tayo.

guarded.EN: Back away into the shadows. Let them wander past.
guarded.TL: Umatras sa dilim. Hayaang lumampas sila.

guarded.EN: I refuse to be butchered in an open field. Retreat.
guarded.TL: Ayokong malapa sa bukas na damuhan. Umatras.

guarded.EN: Keep low and retreat to the last secure building.
guarded.TL: Yumuko at umatras sa huling ligtas na gusali.

guarded.EN: Orderly withdrawal. If anyone runs screaming, they're dead.
guarded.TL: Maayos na pag-atras. Kapag may nagpanic at sumigaw, patay 'yon.

neutral.EN: Hold here. Don't rush it.
neutral.TL: Dito muna. Huwag padalos-dalos.

neutral.EN: Wait for them to thin out before making a move.

neutral.EN: Stay in position. Let's see which way they drift.
neutral.TL: Manatili sa pwesto. Tingnan kung saan sila papunta.

neutral.EN: Hold your ground and observe their path.
neutral.TL: Hawakan ang pwesto at bantayan ang ruta nila.

neutral.EN: No sudden movements. Let them pass if possible.
neutral.TL: Walang biglaang galaw. Hayaang lumampas kung maaari.

neutral.EN: Keep calm and hold the line right here.
neutral.TL: Kumalma at hawakan ang linya dito.

neutral.EN: Patience. Let's wait for the right opening.
neutral.TL: Pasensya muna. Hintayin ang tamang puwang.

neutral.EN: Hold steady. We decide when we have better information.
neutral.TL: Maging matatag. Magpapasya tayo kapag mas marami nang impormasyon.

neutral.EN: Don't panic. Hold position behind cover.
neutral.TL: Huwag mag-panic. Manatili sa likod ng kublihan.

neutral.EN: Steady now. Let's assess before we commit.
neutral.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Timbangin muna bago sumugod.

warm.EN: Stay together. Let's hold before we commit.
warm.TL: Magkakasama tayo. Humawak muna bago sumugod.

warm.EN: Breathe easy, friend. We hold right here by each other.
warm.TL: Huminga ka nang maluwag, kaibigan. Hawak-kamay tayo rito.

warm.EN: I'm right beside you. Let's wait for a safe moment.
warm.TL: Nasa tabi mo lang ako. Hintayin natin ang ligtas na sandali.

warm.EN: Hold steady, partner. We don't have to rush into danger.
warm.TL: Magpakatatag ka, kasama. Di natin kailangang magpadalos-dalos.

warm.EN: Stay low with me. Let's watch their movements together.
warm.TL: Yumuko ka kasabay ko. Sabay nating bantayan ang galaw nila.

warm.EN: Keep calm. As long as we hold together, we'll be fine.
warm.TL: Manatiling kalmado. Hangga't magkasama tayo, magiging maayos tayo.

warm.EN: Just hold on for a minute. Let the worst of the herd pass.
warm.TL: Sandali lang. Hayaang lumampas ang pinakamalaking kawan.

warm.EN: Steady, friend. I'm right here with you in the quiet.
warm.TL: Dahan-dahan, kaibigan. Narito lang ako kasama mo sa katahimikan.

warm.EN: Don't be scared. We hold this spot until we have a clean shot.
warm.TL: Huwag kang matakot. Hawakan ang pwesto hanggang may malinaw na daan.

warm.EN: Together and steady. Let's let them drift away.
warm.TL: Sama-sama at matatag. Hayaan natin silang lumayo.

guarded.EN: No rush. Hold position and watch the pressure.
guarded.TL: Walang pagmamadali. Humawak at bantayan ang galaw nila.

guarded.EN: Hold here. If you twitch, you draw the whole pack.
guarded.TL: Dito muna. Kapag kumilos ka, mahahatak mo ang buong kawan.

guarded.EN: Stay rooted. Wait until their lead walkers pass.
guarded.TL: Manatiling nakatuntong. Hintaying lumampas ang nauuna.

guarded.EN: Maintain silence and hold the corner.
guarded.TL: Panatilihin ang katahimikan at hawakan ang kanto.

guarded.EN: Do not engage prematurely. Let the herd scatter.
guarded.TL: Huwag aatake nang maaga. Hayaang maghiwa-hiwalay ang kawan.

guarded.EN: Hold your breath if you have to, but don't move.
guarded.TL: Pigilin ang hininga kung kailangan, pero huwag gagalaw.

guarded.EN: We wait for an exploitable mistake. Stay still.
guarded.TL: Hintayin natin ang pagkakamali nila. Huwag gumalaw.

guarded.EN: Keep your weapon ready, but do not fire yet. Hold.
guarded.TL: Ihanda ang armas, pero huwag munang puputok. Hawak.

guarded.EN: Hold tight against the wall. Let them walk past.
guarded.TL: Dumikit sa pader. Hayaang maglakad sila palampas.

guarded.EN: Steady. Any sound will turn this into a slaughterhouse.
guarded.TL: Dahan-dahan. Anumang ingay ay gagawin itong katayan.
